stem.text: Objects P and Q form an isolated system.
Object P has mass $6.0\,\text{kg}$ and is moving at a speed of $3.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
Object Q has mass $2.0\,\text{kg}$ and is moving at a speed of $4.2\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ at an angle of $35^{\circ}$ to the path of P.

stem.alt: Diagram of object P (6.0 kg, arrow labelled 3.0 m s^-1) and object Q (2.0 kg, arrow labelled 4.2 m s^-1), with a 35° angle marked between Q's arrow and a dashed horizontal line.

stem.text: Objects P and Q collide and stick together.
What is the magnitude of the component of the final momentum of the combined objects in the original direction of P?
